description: Strips tracking junk off any link you copy — system-wide, not just in the browser. Same real URL, trimmed.
notes: nudl runs in the system tray. On first launch it asks whether to clean links on a hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+V) or automatically as you copy them.
Settings, the rule set and the local audit log live in %AppData%\nudl\.
nudl makes no network calls. Your links never leave your machine.
